rules.title: RAII
rules.text: Manage resources with RAII and smart pointers; avoid raw new and delete.

rules.title: Modern standard
rules.text: Use the project C++ standard features (auto, range-for, std::optional, std::span) where they improve clarity.

rules.title: const correctness
rules.text: Mark everything const that can be const and pass large objects by const reference.

rules.title: Run sanitizers
rules.text: Run tests under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.

rules.title: Warnings as errors
rules.text: Compile with strict warnings (-Wall -Wextra) treated as errors.

rules.title: C++ Core Guidelines
rules.text: Follow the C++ Core Guidelines and clang-tidy checks configured in the repository.
